status: locked design before candidate / seed execution; activation blocked until R1 and exact candidate identity / historical seed audit

research.primary: candidate minus frozen predecessor, paired 4-seat block mean rank utility vs three identical corrected S42-adapter opponents; sole confirmatory endpoint
research.formal_seed_blocks_rule: 160 new blocks at first interim; only futility (95% CI upper <15) or continue same frozen candidate. If continue: second 160 fresh blocks; final single promotion analysis on combined 320. No first-stage promotion. Changed candidate cannot pool old blocks; development selection then at most one independent final confirmation, within preallocated reserves and budget, with protocol before evaluation.
research.power_interpretation: At true +15, point estimate >=15 occurs about half the time; this is threshold design, not lack of power. +20 is design expectation; conservative pilot SD=39.68, n=160 or 320 yields SE≈3.14 or 2.22. Normal approximation only.
research.gate: interim upper 95% CI <15: freeze candidate; otherwise continue unchanged. Final cumulative mean >=15 and lower 95% CI >0: research promotion only (product approval separate); upper CI <15: freeze; otherwise inconclusive/freeze at budget cap. Any correctness failure blocks promotion.
research.ci: paired whole 4-seat seed-block percentile bootstrap 20,000 replicates fixed RNG seed 261120; point effect and CI; primary single endpoint; secondary by opponent and action category descriptive
research.holdouts: session/seed lineage/campaign/opponent family/version group; freeze train/dev/test manifests and seeds; no pilot pooling; existing 30-match dev and 700 games all development/reference, not fresh confirmation; prevent duplicate seed/hash/near-clones; no future/hidden labels in inference; keep exact model hashes, code SHA, rule hash, seed list, replay hashes; failures retry same seed/model, persistent failure invalidates full run not drop
research.baseline: Corrected S42 adapter, guard off, greedy, native second-stage reach and kan heads, tsumogiri and red-consumption detail selection. Source commit 43c99fb1df4e140b35f06f16d4b77247fdc71045 and encoder artifact/hash identified in archive/results/phase0-corrected-20261120.json. Local hanchan rules not original native engine or official Tenhou. Earlier 700 games frozen as legacy adapter reference, not new comparator trials.
research.multiplicity: one formal candidate and one primary condition per development selection; no picking best of test candidates or secondary opponents. If changed candidate is selected after interim, exclude old formal blocks and use independent confirmation only; not a second chance at promotion for same hypothesis.

allocation.note: Five disjoint 160-block units. Last reserved unit not activated without preregistered purpose; no promotion using secondary or arbitrary reserve. Generation cap unchanged 4000. 2 research development cycles max.

research.runtime: Freeze validated Chromium/CPU/WASM runtime and exact binaries; no GPU/unvalidated WebKit result pooling.

product.p1: OOF calibration split by match and campaign; calibrated legal-Ron probability not actual ron choice; p(ron legal) x conditional payment under declared counterfactual rule; use explicit actual loss definition conditioned on accepted ron policy if calling actual loss; no joint probability independence assumptions; no Q-derived physical EV
product.p1_gate: Before training/outer evaluation, freeze calibration/ranking/conditional-loss criteria and stratum support; no unverified point values in UI, uncertainty/small n suppress, no recommendation override; P1 metrics Brier/log loss/reliability/AUPRC, within-decision ranking, conditional point error and risk-loss consistency; dedicated untouched family holdout
product.p2: Mortal unchanged, factual and estimated explanations separately, no causal inference of internal reasoning
product.p2b: Small transfer pilot only after P3-min; Mortal agreement is not itself educational value.
product.p3: counterfactual behavior consistency; not claim of internal causality
product.p2a: External comparison and reasons as supporting/opposing factors, never assert Mortal internal cause; deterministic facts separate from uncertain estimated risk; no Q as points/probability; separate tactical equivalence threshold from numerical drift.
product.p3_min: Critical factual errors zero on preregistered sample; legal matched counterfactual and predicted direction of candidate margin agree with observed direction before P2b.
product.p3_full: Expand situations and factor families; maintain truth/estimate and causal disclaimers.

release_gate: No expanded distribution pending corresponding-source and notice verification; no blanket legal compliance claim; no automatic merge.

margin_gate.scope: gap of first-stage native legal Q top two; concrete second-stage action is tested exactly but its own margin is not separately measured; already-seen fresh trajectories, separate from synthetic calibration, not a new prospective skill holdout

source: 2026-11-20 Phase 0進捗レビュー 統合提言 pp.6–12

phase0_followup.status: limited pass remains; not a blocker for P1/R1
phase0_followup.coverage: Track unseen/rare actions and states in new real simulated logs; report Top1–Top2 gap quantiles, low-margin Top-k and concrete actions separately; numerical threshold 5.72e-5 valid only for checked runtime, remeasure when environment changes; tactical equivalence separate.
